posts.body: Hello there everyone. I am pregnant by mistake. My boyfriend's condom broke and got me pregnant at this young age. I am really worried now. How could I tell my family and y friends. I am thinking of abortion. What should I do. Please suggest me. I don't know what to do. This is really gross. I don't know what I am doing. help me.

Well, abortion is not the solution. You can have many complications in your reproductive system in future if you go for abortion. I know its difficult for you to face the parents and relatives but try to convince them. I don't know what's your age but killing your own child by yourself is really bad. You have done a mistake but now face the world and nourish the baby inside you. I am sure your parents will support you and will not resist for a long time.

Hi there. Please don't panic. Do your family knows about your boyfriend or not? If yes, then you should tell them with love. If no, then go for adoption or get married to your boyfriend. Getting married is the best option. Abortion won't be hidden from parents btw. I wish you all the best. Take care of your diet and health.

I am sorry to hear what you are going through. You didn’t mention how many weeks you are pregnant? As after a certain stage, it’s not safe to go for abortion as it can be harmful to you as well. I would suggest you take the courage to share this with your mom, as she is the one who can guide you in the best possible way.
